title: 第17章 呱我不要恶堕口牙第18章 展示天赋这一块
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
来到城门口不远处时，莉莉丝停下了脚步。
季天回头看了她一眼。
她站在原地，裹着那件明显不合身的灰色斗篷，银白色的长发从兜帽边缘漏出来几缕，在夜风里轻轻飘着。
她的表情……不太好。
像是站在悬崖边上，往下看了一眼，然后发现自己的鞋带松了。
“怎么了？”
她抬起手，食指上那枚布满裂纹的银色戒指在月光下泛着死寂的光，“戒指，坏了。”
“我知道，我打坏的。”
“……你倒是承认得挺痛快。”莉莉丝深吸一口气，“我的意思是，它坏了，我就没办法隐藏魔族气息了。你让我进入要塞城市？里面有很多强者，勇者小队可能还在里面吃饭，逛街，万一不小心碰到了怎么办？”
她顿了顿，又左右摇摆似是撒娇，惺惺然作处子态，装出一副可怜的样子，“你舍得看到我这么可爱的美少女被勇者一剑砍成美少女碎片吗？”
“你是魔族。”季天施法，断绝了声音向外传递的可能。
“魔族美少女也是美少女。”莉莉丝小声辩解道，接着又试探着开口，“要不，您老大人有大量，把人家当个屁放了？”
季天没有回答这个问题。他看了她两秒，然后伸出手。
莉莉丝下意识往后退了一步，双手抱头蹲下，“啊啊啊，莉莉丝错了莉莉丝再也不敢口嗨啦。”
季天的手没有握成拳。他的手掌摊开，五指微张，悬在她面前半尺的地方。
然后捏了个敛气术放在她身上。
莉莉丝愣了一下。
她感觉到有什么东西从季天的掌心散发出来，那是一种她说不上来的、像是风又不是风、像水又不是水的东西。
它从季天的掌心溢出，像一层极薄的雾，无声无息地包裹住她的全身。
那种感觉很奇妙。

像被人从头到脚浇了一盆温水，不烫，但很密实，每一寸皮肤都被严严实实地包裹住了。
季天收回手。
“好了。”
“……什么好了？”
“你的气息。我封住了。”
莉莉丝站立起来，低头看了看自己，又摸了摸脸，什么都没感觉到。
“你封住了？用什么封的？你连咒语都没念，连法杖都没拿——”
“不需要那些。”
“那你用的什么？”
“术法。”
莉莉丝眨了眨眼，似是全然忘了刚刚抱头蹲下的恐惧，“……术法？那是什么？魔法的分支？失传的古代魔法体系？还是你自己编的词？”
“是。”季天说完这个字，转身走向城门口。
白天的科尔德城门口人来人往，守卫只是盯着来往的马车和辎重检查，基本上不会管来往行人。
过了城门，莉莉丝这才接着提问：
“是哪个？分支？古代体系？还是你自己编的？”
“都是。”
莉莉丝被噎了一下，她张了张嘴，想追问，又觉得追问下去可能会再挨一拳。
她小跑着跟上去，一边跑一边小声嘀咕：“都是是什么意思？三个都是？那到底是哪个？这个人说话怎么跟挤牙膏似的……”
content_en:
When they arrived not far from the city gate, Lilith stopped.
Ji Tian looked back at her.
She stood there, wrapped in the gray cloak that obviously didn't fit. A few strands of her long silver hair leaked out from the edge of the hood, fluttering gently in the night wind.
Her expression... wasn't very good.
It was like standing on the edge of a cliff, looking down, and then realizing that his shoelaces were loose.
"What's wrong?"
She raised her hand, and the cracked silver ring on her index finger glowed deathly in the moonlight, "The ring is broken."
"I know, I broke it."
"...You admitted it quite happily." Lilith took a deep breath, "I mean, if it breaks down, I won't be able to hide the demonic aura. You want me to enter the fortress city? There are many strong people inside, and the brave team may still be eating or shopping there. What if I accidentally bump into it?"
She paused, then swayed from side to side as if coquettishly, pretending to be pitiful, "Are you willing to see such a lovely girl like me chopped into pieces by a brave sword?"
"You are a demon." Ji Tian cast a spell, cutting off the possibility of the sound being transmitted outwards.
"Beautiful demon girls are also beautiful girls." Lilith defended in a low voice, and then tentatively said, "How about you, sir, have so many people that you treat them like shit?"
Ji Tian did not answer this question. He looked at her for two seconds and then extended his hand.
Lilith subconsciously took a step back, put her head in her hands and squatted down, "Ah ah, Lilith is wrong. Lilith doesn't dare to have oral pleasure anymore."
Ji Tian's hands were not clenched into fists. His palms were spread out, his fingers slightly spread, hanging half a foot in front of her.
Then he pinched a Qi Condensing Technique and placed it on her body.
Lilith was stunned for a moment.
She felt something emanating from Ji Tian's palm. It was something she couldn't describe, something like wind but not wind, like water but not water.
It overflowed from Ji Tian's palm, like a very thin layer of mist, wrapping her whole body silently.
That feeling is amazing.
It was like someone poured a basin of warm water from head to toe. It was not hot, but very dense. Every inch of skin was tightly wrapped.
Ji Tian took back his hand.
"Okay."
"...What's better?"
"Your breath. I sealed it."
Lilith stood up, looked down at herself, and touched her face, but felt nothing.
"Did you seal it? What did you use to seal it? You didn't even recite the incantation, and you didn't even take the staff -"
"No need for that."
"Then what did you use?"
"Magic."
Lilith blinked, seeming to have completely forgotten the fear of squatting down with her head in her hands, "...spell? What is that? A branch of magic? A lost ancient magic system? Or did you make up the words yourself?"
"Yes." After Ji Tian said this word, he turned and walked towards the city gate.
During the day, people were coming and going at the gate of Cold City. The guards only watched the passing carriages and checked the baggage, and basically ignored the pedestrians.
After passing the city gate, Lilith continued to ask:
"Which one is it? A branch? An ancient system? Or did you make it up yourself?"
"Both."
Lilith was choked. She opened her mouth and wanted to ask more questions, but she felt that if she continued to ask, she might get punched again.
She trotted to follow, muttering in a low voice as she ran: "What do they all mean? All three? Which one is it? Why does this person talk like he is squeezing out toothpaste..."
